title: Quickstart Schema Cards and Inline Validation Mockups
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of quickstart visual assets and in-product mockups that explain JSON schema structured output for new developers. Deliverables include: (1) compact "schema cards" for the quickstart doc that show a minimal schema, accepted example, and bad example; (2) inline validation UI mockups for the Console and hosted API docs (soft validation warnings vs hard rejection errors); (3) copy and microcopy for error states and developer tips; (4) screenshot-ready artboards and export-ready assets for docs release and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Three schema card variants finalized: Basic, Nested Object, and Array of Objects
Inline validation mockups for Console request editor: idle, warning, and error states (desktop and mobile)
Docs-ready PNG/JPG exports at 2x for all frames with filenames matching doc references
Developer microcopy approved by PM and Engineering and committed to docs repo
Accessibility check: contrast and label semantics documented in handoff notes

Iterate with PM (Nora Blake) on example schemas and copy

design_notes: Schema card layout should prioritize readable JSON snippets: use monospace, 14px base for desktop, 12px for mobile
Use color system: green success, amber soft-warning, red hard-error. Avoid red-only indicators; include iconography and text
Provide one 'copy example' CTA per card that inserts the example into the Console editor in the real product
